title: FIND FREQUENCY OF CIFTI LABELS
description: This command outputs a set of soft ROIs, one for each label in the input, where the value is how many of the input maps had that label at that vertex/voxel, divided by the number of input maps.

label_maps.description: cifti dlabel file containing individual label maps from many subjects

probability_dscalar_out.description: the relative frequencies of each label at each vertex/voxel

exclude_unlabeled.description: don't make a probability map of the unlabeled key
